title: CFGComposer: Compositional Audio-Text-to-Motion Generation via Copula Score Correction
role: The same product-plus-interaction score decomposition in the motion domain, with the interaction estimated from a small jointly trained denoiser instead of a classifier.
reads: All three denoisers read the noisy motion x_t at every step, with Whisper audio features, a caption embedding and, for the joint model, a gesture-window embedding.
trained_on: Frozen audio and text experts on BEAT and a motion-caption set; a joint model on 775 clips for 50k steps with x0 regression, uniform t and joint dropout 0.1.
score_enters: No classifier gradient: epsilon_total = epsilon_PoE + lambda (epsilon_AT2M - epsilon_PoE) at every step, lambda = 0.7, no cap.
adding_scores: Adding scores is exact only when the copula score is zero; independence given clean data does not survive noising.
properties: none of the five in images; prompt match is measured in motion through SRGR, G-MSE and human semantic ratings.
unseen: no: no held-out concepts are tested.
headline: On BEAT, SRGR (0 to 1, higher better) is 0.9916 and motion FID (lower better) is 27.18, against best fine-tuned baselines of 0.8018 for RoboGesture and 62.31 for DiffSHEG.
copy_or_avoid: Copy the decomposition and the full-range lambda plot; avoid the guided-against-unguided mismatch and do not read this as evidence for a sentence-score gradient (inferred).
model: Motion diffusion Transformer (MDM-style) on BEAT, no image model

disagreements.claim: The copula score vanishes if and only if a and c are independent given x_t.
disagreements.paper_says: The score is a gradient in x, so it also vanishes when the log ratio is a nonzero constant in x for the given a and c (inferred).

disagreements.claim: The PoE baseline instantiates the unit-weight product of Eq. 7.
disagreements.paper_says: Eq. 14 and 15 use guidance 5 and weights 1 and 1.6, normalised, while Algorithm 2 shows no guidance on the joint model, so the difference is not the clean interaction term (inferred).
